description: Add data to a project from a public download link (GeoPackage, zipped Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML, CSV with coordinates or GeoTIFF, up to 200 MB): your own model's output, a survey, a map. Side effect: the file is downloaded, stored and added to the project, where its team can see it; nothing is deleted or overwritten. Biohotspot then checks it; follow its status with list_project_data and finish anything it asks for in the project's Uploads tab. Needs owner or editor rights.
